description: Source code for ApiParser class that processes Markdown API documentation files, extracting classes, methods, properties, and arguments, and applying templates. It includes functions for parsing variable lines, extracting metadata, and handling documentation nodes.

classes.name: ApiParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing Markdown API documentation files, extracting class, method, property, and argument information, and constructing documentation data structures.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes ApiParser, reads Markdown files from directory, parses content, and builds class and documentation structures.

methods.name: parseClass
methods.description: Parses a class definition node, extracting class name, inheritance, and metadata.

methods.name: parseMember
methods.description: Parses class member nodes such as methods, events, and properties, extracting their metadata and types.

methods.name: parseArgument
methods.description: Parses method argument or option nodes, associating them with class methods.

methods.name: parseProperty
methods.description: Parses property definitions within documentation nodes.

methods.name: parseType
methods.description: Parses type definitions from documentation nodes, including nested properties.

methods.name: parseVariable
methods.description: Parses variable, return, type, or argument lines to extract name, type, and optionality.

methods.name: applyTemplates
methods.description: Applies template replacements within documentation nodes based on parameters.

methods.name: extractMetainfo
methods.description: Extracts metadata such as language, since version, deprecation, and hidden status from documentation nodes.

methods.name: extractComments
methods.description: Extracts comment nodes from documentation nodes, filtering out headers and default list items.

methods.name: checkNoDuplicateParamEntries
methods.description: Checks for duplicate parameter entries in the parameter nodes.
